newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar closes flat on cenbnk dlr sales.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar closes flat on cenbnk dlr sales.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed broadly flat at around 471.50/472.50 bolivars per dollar as the Central Bank covered strong dollar demand with dollar sales, traders said.
"Corporate demand for dollars was high and the Central Bank was the main seller," said one trader.
The Central Bank did not release a reference closing price due to the Thanksgiving holiday in the U.S. It will next release a reference rate Friday.
